Controls
Right drag: rotate
Middle (wheel) drag: pan
Scroll: zoom
Left click: the active tool
Esc: cancel the active tool
Trackpad: Option + drag rotates, Shift + drag pans
Touch: one finger rotates, two fingers pan and zoom

How to use it
1. Scan your prep and export it as STL
2. Choose the file under "Your prep scan"
3. Read the feedback panel on the right
4. Click a feedback row to see where it was measured
5. Explore Reduction and Convergence for more detail
Nothing is uploaded or saved. Workflow
1. Load the unprepared tooth once, then each student prep
2. Set the orientation (asked once per reference, then reused)
3. Open the Grade sheet: the measured rows fill in on their own
4. Probe the clearance and measure the wall heights
5. Judge the remaining rows, then save to the class log
6. Export the class CSV when you are done
